entries.speaker: Mr. Ushimaru
entries.en: You! Pay attention! Is that how you listen[n]when someone's talking to you!?

entries.speaker: Female Student
entries.en: Whoa! That was an epic dodge!

entries.speaker: Male Student
entries.en: That was nuts... Is he a ninja?

entries.speaker: Mr. Ushimaru
entries.en: So you were awake... Hmph.[n]I couldn't even tell.

entries.speaker: Female Student
entries.en: Ooh... That looked like it hurt.

entries.speaker: Male Student
entries.en: *snicker* He hit him right in[n]the forehead...

entries.speaker: Mr. Ushimaru
entries.en: That's what you get for nodding off.

entries.speaker: Mr. Ushimaru
entries.en: Kids these days have no respect for[n]their elders.

entries.speaker: Female Student
entries.en: No way! He just ignored it!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I like that aura you've got about you.[n]It's like nothing gets to you.
